scene: The star chart reveals three secret city routes.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view. On the far left, a driver waits beside a green bicycle rickshaw. In the centre, the player leans on his cane, looking at the purple-coated astronomer pointing to an open parchment. On the right, a yellow water taxi bobs at a wooden pier. Up high on the far right, metal monorail stairs ascend.
shown: A green bicycle rickshaw waiting parked at the far left
A yellow water taxi moored at a jetty on the right
An elevated monorail boarding platform up high on the far right

variants.scene: By warm lantern light, the unfolded chart shows three paths through the nighttime city.
